features.name: Synthetic Sentinel-2-style scene generator
features.summary: Generates offline 128x128 5-band reflectance tiles for 5 land-cover classes plus simulated logging patches; no real imagery loader exists.

features.name: Spectral index feature extraction (NDVI, NDWI, NBR, EVI)
features.summary: Builds per-pixel features from 5 bands plus 4 spectral indices.

features.name: Random-forest forest/non-forest classifier with 3x3 majority filter
features.summary: Trains a 120-tree RandomForest on 12 simulated scenes and smooths predictions with a median filter; trained only on simulated data.
features.registry_match: Random-forest land classification and bias correction

features.name: Held-out accuracy, F1, confusion matrix and false-loss rate
features.summary: Evaluates on 6 unseen simulated scenes, draws a stratified reference sample for the confusion matrix, and measures the false-change rate.

features.name: Olofsson-style bias-corrected area with 95% CI
features.summary: Stratified estimator that corrects mapped forest area using the confusion matrix and returns a 95% interval.
features.registry_match: Random-forest land classification and bias correction

features.name: Change detection and reversal deduction
features.summary: Counts forest-to-nonforest pixels, subtracts expected classifier false loss, applies a 3-sigma significance test, and deducts a reversal at 550 tCO2e/ha.

features.name: Conservative crediting and verdict status
features.summary: Credits are issued on the lower CI bound at 8 tCO2e/ha/yr; status is VERIFIED, OVER-CLAIMED, REVERSAL or REJECTED (110% over-claim flag).

features.name: Canonical SHA-256 report hash
features.summary: Each verification report is serialized canonically and hashed for on-chain anchoring.
features.registry_match: Unique serials and report hashes on-chain

features.name: End-to-end pipeline over 5 fictional projects
features.summary: python ml/run_pipeline.py trains, verifies five hardcoded fictional projects, writes results.json and evidence-map JPEGs.

features.name: CarbonRegistry Solidity contract
features.summary: Owner registers projects and approved verifiers submit one verification per project-period, minting min(claimed, verified) credits with status Verified, OverClaimed, Reversal or Rejected.

features.name: Globally unique credit serial ranges and one verification per period
features.summary: nextSerial allocates contiguous serial ranges and PeriodAlreadyVerified blocks double issuance.
features.registry_match: Unique serials and report hashes on-chain

features.name: On-chain report hash check (checkReport)
features.summary: Public view that compares a published report hash with the stored one.
features.registry_match: Unique serials and report hashes on-chain

features.name: Credit transfer and permanent retirement
features.summary: Balances per project; retire() burns credits from circulation with a beneficiary string so they cannot be reused.

features.name: Deploy and anchor script
features.summary: Hardhat script deploys the registry, registers each project, submits verifications from results.json, retires a quarter of one project's credits and writes ledger.json.

features.name: Optional Polygon Amoy testnet deployment config
features.summary: hardhat.config.js adds an amoy network when AMOY_RPC_URL and DEPLOYER_KEY env vars are set; the shipped ledger shows only a local hardhat chain.

features.name: Hardhat contract test suite
features.summary: 12 tests cover registration, issuance caps, reversal, double issuance, serial uniqueness, access control, report check, transfer and retirement; not executed by the audit.

features.name: USE_LOCAL_SOLC offline compiler override
features.summary: Hardhat subtask swaps in npm solc-js when the compiler download is blocked.

features.name: Self-contained dashboard build script
features.summary: Inlines results.json, ledger.json and base64 map images into template.html to produce dashboard/index.html.

features.name: Claimed vs verified credits dashboard
features.summary: Single-page chart of claimed vs supported credits per project with totals and a per-project detail panel (claims, imagery findings, on-chain record, report hash).

features.name: Method and model metrics panel
features.summary: Shows the five-step method, classifier accuracy, F1, false-change rate, accuracy sample and registry contract address.

features.name: Devpost write-up and demo scripts
features.summary: DEVPOST_SUBMISSION.md, DEMO_VIDEO_SCRIPT.md, VOICEOVER_SCRIPT.md and preview.png exist; contents were not read.

features.name: Documented limitations and roadmap
features.summary: README states imagery is simulated, carbon parameters are simplified, the verifier is a single trusted address, and real Sentinel-2/GEE, GEDI, multi-verifier and ERC-1155 are roadmap only.
